notes.zh: 随机遗址：基础权重1000，出现在所有非恒星、非小行星、非干旱/草原/沙漠的星球上；全银河最多一处（common/archaeological_site_types/12_strange_worlds_arc_sites.txt:1）。
notes.en: A random site with base weight 1000 on any body that is not a star, asteroid, arid, savannah or desert world; at most one per galaxy (common/archaeological_site_types/12_strange_worlds_arc_sites.txt:1).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
